messages:
kari: rolled v4.5 to canaries in us-west ~4m ago. quick checks passed but smokebot shows intermittent 504s on /v1/embed.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.5 -> canaries deployed (6/6). tag: v4.5.0.

smokebot: synthetic-run -> /v1/embed returned 2/6 failures; failures from usw-can-01. elevated p95.

ben: checking logs/metrics: usw-can-01 kv_prefill_backlog=8, worker_count=1, proxy shows upstream read_timeouts.

kari: running targeted probe against usw-can-01: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://usw-can-01.api.redwood/v1/embed -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" -d '{\"input\":\"probe\"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

kari: results x3 -> 200 0.17, 504 0.33, 200 0.16. intermittent as smokebot flagged.

infra: host snapshot -> kv_prefill_backlog=8 workers=1.

ben: hypothesis: prefill lag on startup. triggering targeted prefill with concurrency=3.

ben: prefill output: \"queued 4 prefixes -> processed 4 -> completed in 15s\".

smokebot: re-run synthetic -> /v1/embed 6/6 success from usw-can-01. p50/p95 within baseline.

kari: recommendation: resume rollforward in 10m, pin v4.5 on canaries for 12h, enable temp alert for embed p99 and kv_prefill_backlog>5 for 12h. add ops playbook entry: if post-upgrade 5xxs occur, run targeted prefill and hold rollout.

ben: filed INFRA-7333 to improve prefill concurrency and expose startup progress metric.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollforward to remainder of us-west in 10m from 6180000080.

kari: updating internal release notes: \"v4.5.0 - gradual. Note: transient prefill lag on canary usw-can-01 caused intermittent 504s to /v1/embed; targeted prefill executed and verification passed; rollout resumed with 10m observation and 12h canary pin.\"

smokebot: reaction :white_check_mark:.

ben: oncall checklist: 1) monitor embed p99 2) confirm prefill drain on new hosts 3) abort and pin if failure rate >4% over 5m.

kari: i'll watch the channel for the observation window. closing thread after 12h if stable.
